examples: A question arrives and a yellow tab appears beside agents; answer it and the tab goes away.
Choose edit layout and the sidebar opens on an edit layout tab holding the widget drawer; close the tab to finish.
how_to: Press a tab's key on the sidebar rail, or move between keys with the arrow keys.
A tab with a close key (edit layout) closes with it, or with Delete while its key is focused.
Menu and agents are remembered on this device; questions and edit layout appear only while they have something to show.
A tab with a pop out key in its title row (the task manager) opens in its own resizable window, remembered where you left it.
On a phone, the back arrow on a page opened from the drawer returns to the drawer on the tab you left; a page opened from another page returns to that page first.
media_exempt: the rail keys and their states are shown in the style guide's chrome section (the sidebar rail)
name: Sidebar tabs
summary: the left sidebar's tabs open and close when they have something to show: menu and agents always, questions while something waits, edit layout while you edit.
where: The keys of the sidebar rail down the left edge of the left sidebar.
